scope_banner: ZERO-CONTAINER census for owner decision.  NO Docker, NO Full-D7 unit execution, NO git freeze.  Units outside the Calibration-12 validated domain (python_version==3.12 AND lock_type==poetry) are labelled OUT_OF_VALIDATED_SCOPE, never classified as environment failure and never labelled NOT_READY in this census.

validated_domain.note: All 25 py312-poetry units resolve under the frozen resolver; the Calibration-12 executed 12 of them (FIRST_12_FROZEN_ORDER) with 12/12 PASS under source-fidelity-r1.

worktrees.note: existence only for the 219; no full 219 byte-verification performed (per owner scope-census instruction)

ntfs_invalid.note: skipped paths are VCR test cassettes only (test data, never closure-derivation or frozen-gate inputs); all 38 tasks are member tasks of py39-poetry units, which are OUT_OF_VALIDATED_SCOPE in this census

dry_run.method: frozen d7_r3_closure.derive_runtime_closure (pyver=unit python_version) + frozen d7_r3_closure.resolve_runtime_artifacts against era wheelhouse (wheelhouse/<era> + canon_r4b/<era>); zero container execution

limitations.py312_only_wheel_tag_gate: The frozen R3 wheel-tag gate (d7_r3_wheeltags) targets CPython 3.12 only.  py38/py39 era wheels (cp38/cp39 non-abi3) are not accepted by the frozen resolver, so py38/py39 strata cannot pass the frozen resolution gate as frozen.  This is a FROZEN-AUTHORITY LIMITATION, not an environment failure.  py38/py39 units = OUT_OF_VALIDATED_SCOPE.
limitations.uv_editable_self_and_markers: The frozen R3 closure derivation reads all lock package entries as name==version pins; uv.lock editable-self (saleor==X, source virtual='.') is not excluded by the frozen R3 poetry_pins, and uv marker semantics are not applied by the frozen R3 closure path.  uv.lock units = OUT_OF_VALIDATED_SCOPE (not classified here).  Observed: all 21 uv units report missing 'saleor==X' (editable self) and 'python-magic-bin==0.4.14' under the frozen closure path.

missing_worktree_policy: A missing member-task worktree FAILS CLOSED (never a silent smoke skip): the closure derivation only applies the win32 python-magic-bin exclusion when the member-task pyproject.toml is present, and smoke requires the mounted worktree.  Both are enforced as FAIL-CLOSED by the Full-D7 driver when it is authorized.
owner_decision_required: The frozen resolver, as frozen (py312-only wheel-tag gate + no uv editable-self exclusion), leaves 119/144 units OUT_OF_VALIDATED_SCOPE and only the 25 py312-poetry units inside the validated domain.  Owner must decide: (A) proceed with Full D7 limited to the Calibration-validated py312-poetry domain only, or (B) authorize a scope decision for py38/py39/uv strata, or (C) freeze the census as the Full-D7 result.
